pub struct Invalid;

/// Checked by a method returning its own type by name, with a field visible outside the module.
pub struct Name {
    pub text: String,
    checked: (),
}
impl Name {
    pub fn renamed(&self, text: &str) -> Result<Name, Invalid> {
        if text.is_empty() { Err(Invalid) } else { Ok(Name { text: text.to_owned(), checked: self.checked }) }
    }
}
